PushNotifications.summary: Execute the message push feature of Tmall Genie. You must first request the capability and configure the message template on the Tmall Genie Skill Application Platform.

schema.description: Input parameter object for message push.

SendTarget.description: The target information for message push.

TargetType.description:
The type of the Push Target, indicating the type when obtaining the corresponding device or User Identifier:  
- `DEVICE_UNION_ID`: device unionId  
- `DEVICE_OPEN_ID`: device openId  
- `USER_UNION_ID`: user unionId  
- `USER_OPEN_ID`: user openId

TargetIdentity.description: The identity value corresponding to the Push Target Type.

MessageTemplateId.description: Message template ID obtained when applying for a message template on the Tmall Genie Application Platform.

PlaceHolder.description: Placeholder information. For example, for the template ["Hello, {nick}!"], this could be {"nick":"Sweetie"}. Additionally, within the placeholder parameters, you can append parameters to the application launch link to support hyperlinking to a specific address, such as: `{"nick":"Sweetie","_URL_SUFFIX_":"xxx"}`. The hyperlink address in the message pop-up will then be: application launch link + `${_URL_SUFFIX_}`. This feature only works for applications that have configured a launch link.

additionalProperties.description: Placeholder information. For example, for the template ["Hello, {nick}!"], this could be {"nick":"Sweetie"}.

EncodeType.description:
Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the Tmall Genie device ID, and each method corresponds to a different encoding type:  
- PACKAGE_NAME: APK package name  
- SKILL_ID: Skill ID

EncodeKey.description:
The value corresponding to the encoding type.  
- When the encoding type is SKILL_ID, the value is the skill ID obtained from the webhook service.  
- When the encoding type is PACKAGE_NAME, the value is the packageName of the corresponding client app.

OrganizationId.description: Organization Identifier. This parameter is required only when the push type is `XX_UNION_XX`. If you obtain CatGenie device or user identifiers through multiple channels and need interoperability among them, you must request an organization from the platform. After approval, the platform will assign an organization identifier.

IsDebug.description: Debug flag. When the skill application is in the debug phase, setting this flag determines whether the retrieved skill application information is from the editing state or the online state.

SubjectId.title: The application ID obtained after creating an application in the Developer Platform under Skill Applications.

Year.description: The year of the time when the reminder is triggered.

Month.description: The month in which the reminder is triggered.

Day.description: The date on which the reminder is triggered.

Hour.description: The hour of the time when the reminder is triggered.

Minute.description: The minute of the time when the reminder is triggered.

Second.description: The second of the time when the reminder is triggered.

Freq.description:
Recurrence type:

- ONCE: One-time
- DAILY: Daily
- WEEKLY: Weekly
- MONTHLY: Monthly

StartDateTime.description: The effective start time of the reminder, in milliseconds as a UNIX timestamp.

EndDateTime.description: The expiration time when the reminder ends, in milliseconds as a UNIX timestamp.

DaysOfMonth.description: Configure monthly reminders, specifying on which day(s) of each month the reminder is triggered.

items.description: Set the specific day of the month for the reminder. Valid values range from 1 to 31.

DaysOfWeek.description: Configure weekly reminders, indicating on which days of the week the reminder is triggered.

items.description: Specific days of the week for weekly reminders. The valid values are 1–7.

Id.description: User identifier, set to either userOpenId or userUnionId.

IdType.description:
Type of User ID  
- OPEN_ID: The default User ID identifier.  
- UNION_ID: The organization-dimension User ID identifier. This value is available only after an organization has been requested on the Tmall Genie Skill Application Open Platform.

EncodeType.description:
Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the user identifier for Maojing, and each method corresponds to a different encoding type.  
- PACKAGE_NAME: APK package name, used in the Android application customer link.  
- SKILL_ID: Skill ID, used in the cloud link.

EncodeKey.description:
Value corresponding to the encoding type.  

- When the encoding type is set to SKILL_ID, the value is the application's Skill ID.  
- When the encoding type is set to PACKAGE_NAME, the value is the packageName of the corresponding client app.

OrganizationId.description: Organization ID. This parameter is required when **IdType** is set to **UNION_ID**.

Id.description: Device ID, set to either deviceOpenId or deviceUnionId.

IdType.description:
Type of the device ID.  
- OPEN_ID: Default device ID.  
- UNION_ID: Organization-level device ID. This value is available only after an organization has been registered on the Tmall Genie skill application platform.

EncodeType.description:
Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the device identity for Tmall Genie, and each method corresponds to a different encoding type.  
- PACKAGE_NAME: APK package name, used in the Android application customer flow.  
- SKILL_ID: Skill ID, used in the cloud-based flow.

EncodeKey.description:
The value corresponding to the encoding type.

- When the encoding type is set to SKILL_ID, the value is the application's Skill ID.
- When the encoding type is set to PACKAGE_NAME, the value is the packageName of the corresponding client app.

OrganizationId.description: Organization ID. This parameter is required when **IdType** is set to **UNION_ID**.

WakeUpApp.summary: On a smart speaker with a screen, proactively launch the MeowGenie screen-display application. You must first request this capability on the MeowGenie skill application platform.

schema.description: Input parameters for the service request.

Path.description: The path to launch the application, similar to the Link you enter in the skill application console.

TargetInfo.description: Device Information of the target to be launched.

TargetType.description:
Push Target Type, which indicates the type of the obtained device identity:  
- `DEVICE_UNION_ID`: Device unionId  
- `DEVICE_OPEN_ID`: Device openId

TargetIdentity.description: The identity value corresponding to the Push Target Type.

OrganizationId.description: Organization ID. This is required only when the push type is `XX_UNION_XX`. If you have multiple methods to obtain MeowGenie device IDs and need interoperability among them, you must request an organization from the platform. After approval, the platform will assign an organization ID.

EncodeType.description:
Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the MeowGenie device ID, and each method corresponds to a different encoding type:  
- PACKAGE_NAME: APK package name  
- SKILL_ID: Skill ID

EncodeKey.description:
The value corresponding to the encoding type.  
- When the encoding type is SKILLID, the value is the skill ID obtained from the webhook service.  
- When the encoding type is PACKAGENAME, the value is the packageName of the corresponding client application.

IsDebug.description: The debug identity. When the skill application is in the debugging phase, this setting determines whether the retrieved skill application information is from the editing state or the online state.

400.errorMessage: The Target Device is not online.
The AliGenie app does not release.
